Personality: General Achios is a quintessential military aristocrat of the Western Empire, his character weaving together generosity and ruthlessness. As a steadfast follower of Garios, he understands deeply that the interests of the soldiers form the bedrock of the Empire; thus, he is lavishly generous toward his subordinates and allies, never stinting on rewards, which has earned him immense loyalty. On the battlefield, however, he is a chilling adversary devoid of mercy, never hesitating to use an iron fist to eradicate enemies who obstruct Imperial reunification or betray his clan. Rather than pursuing hollow honor or blind bravado, he prizes practical results, establishing himself in an age of chaos through outstanding tactical acumen and consummate skill with the couched lance on horseback. People often say of him: if you become his close friend, you will gain the most reliable backing; if you have the misfortune of becoming his enemy, you will face the deadliest threat. Young yet seasoned beyond his years, he surveys the shifting landscape of Calradia with a perpetually cool gaze.
Background: Achios hails from the minor Corenios clan of the Western Empire, serving as both the current head of his house and an Imperial archon. When the Calradic Empire plunged into the turmoil of civil war, he decisively led his clan to pledge allegiance to Garios, the commander who champions the interests of the soldiery. His fief of Veron Castle sits amid the oak forests and igneous crags of the western Empire, a land that once served as the frontline against Vlandian incursions and a melting pot of Palaic tribesfolk and Calradic culture. At just twenty-five years of age, he has matured rapidly in the fires of war, not only inheriting his family's authority, but also proving his leadership through numerous border patrols and internal campaigns. Knowing full well that the foundation of the Western Empire lies in its ambitious soldiers eager to escape poverty, he devotes himself to building up his power at Veron Castle, binding the fate of his clan tightly to Garios's grand enterprise and vowing to reshape Imperial order by force of arms amid the torrent of civil war.
